definitions.explanation: A beautiful woman of heaven in Buddhist and Japanese folklore, pictured flying in a robe of feathers; also used as a compliment for a woman of unearthly beauty.

examples.japanese: {天女|てんにょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}い{降|お}りた→舞い降りる：14060_maioriru⟧。
examples.english: A celestial maiden came dancing down from the sky.

examples.japanese: {天女|てんにょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{羽衣|はごろも}→羽衣：33530_hagoromo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っています→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you know the legend of the celestial maiden's feather robe?

examples.japanese: ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{笛|ふえ}→笛：03593_fue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧{天女|てんにょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: On the temple ceiling, celestial maidens are painted flying through the sky playing flutes.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In the ⟦{羽衣|はごろも}→羽衣：33530_hagoromo⟧ legend, a fisherman finds a {天女|てんにょ}'s feather robe and will return it only if she dances for him; the story is the basis of the Noh play ⟦{羽衣|はごろも}→羽衣：33530_hagoromo⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天使|てんし}→天使：12174_tenshi⟧: an angel, from the Christian tradition
